name: agent-builder-model-map-reconciliation
body: The `agent-builder` maintains the repo's `opencode.json` agent→model map and interviews for preferred model mappings. `opencode.json` is a main-write surface under carve-out 1 of `global.constraint.worktree-isolation`, alongside `.opencode/agents/**`; `codebase-navigator` is absent from the map. The edited surface is `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md`. `requirements.constraint.agent-changes-always-on-main`, `global.constraint.worktree-isolation`, `domain.entity.agent-model-map`, `domain.entity.agent-scaffold-flow`, and `solution.component.agent-builder-prompt` state the same surface. The spine is `requirements.user.navigator-agent` ⊃ `requirements.requirement.agent-builder-model-map` —drives→ `domain.entity.agent-model-map` —realised-by→ `solution.component.agent-builder-prompt` —implemented-by→ `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md`.
